deals.evidence: FSG bought the Penguins in late 2021 for $900 million
deals.headline: Fenway Sports Group buys the Penguins for $900m
deals.summary: FSG acquired a controlling interest in the Penguins in 2021, adding the team to a portfolio including the Boston Red Sox and Liverpool FC.

deals.evidence: The enterprise value in the deal was $1.7 billion, according to someone familiar with the agreement.
deals.headline: Hoffmann family buys controlling interest in the Penguins from FSG
deals.summary: Definitive agreement announced December 2025; NHL Board of Governors approved unanimously June 23, 2026. Enterprise value $1.7bn per Sportico's source; FSG stays a minority shareholder for a period; the SportsNet Pittsburgh RSN equity transfers to the Hoffmanns. Allen & Co. and CAA Evolution advised FSG.

name: Pittsburgh Penguins
notes: US team: no published accounts; revenue, operating income (EBITDA) and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2024-25, valuation is Forbes enterprise value calculated December 2025 (before the Hoffmann sale closed; Forbes still lists FSG). Deal value: the release says terms were not disclosed; the $1.7bn enterprise value is Sportico's sourced report. Stake percentages not stated ("controlling interest"); FSG minority stake is described as temporary and may have ended. Capacity: the SEA page gives 18387 in key facts but 'approximately 18,087' in its text; the arena's FAQ says 18,187. Missing: social, shirt/kit sponsor, net debt, revenue breakdown (Forbes gate receipts $71M).
